winchester.s1_head: Kitting the events trade of Winchester
s1loc: Winchester runs a live scene that mixes a historic stage, a cathedral and the open downs. The Theatre Royal Winchester on Jewry Street carries drama, dance, comedy and music through the year, while Winchester Cathedral hosts concerts and recitals under its great nave. Hat Fair, the UK's longest-running festival of street theatre, fills the city streets and Abbey Gardens each July, and Boomtown brings a vast five-day production to the Matterley Estate on the downs nearby.

And the trade runs at every size across Hampshire.
